notes.title: Try Flying Frags Classic!
notes.notes:
You can now play the original Flying Frags on Steam! You have the option to play it before opening the game. Although it isn't as polished as World Tour, it's an enjoyable experience to play it alongside World Tour to see how the stories connect.

[previewyoutube=aS6ECXth8CM;full][/previewyoutube]

Flying Frags is a fast paced, arcade-action shooter where the goal is to kill every enemy as fast as possible. You have 5 different weapons and 2 midair jumps to traverse 11 abstract arenas and defeat the boss.
